product_summary: Website amiableimpex.com (Borivali West, Mumbai; factories at Palghar - Hamrapur Wada, Maharashtra, and Jamnagar, Gujarat) lists a coherent electrical-earthing product portfolio: (1) exothermic/thermit welding powder + graphite moulds, IEEE 837-2014, UL certified; (2) thermit welding kits, RDSO-approved for Indian Railways; (3) copper-bonded earth rods / grounding rods, IEC 62561-2, UL certified; (4) copper cable lugs / terminal lugs, IEC 61238-1; (5) brass cable glands, earthing clamps, connectors, brass fittings/components, IEC 62444; (6) copper braid/rope/flat, copper stranded and copper-clad conductors; (7) earth enhancement compound and earth pit, IEC 62561-5. Site also mentions 'small track machines' and alumino-thermit (AT) welding kits for railways. Claimed founding year 2012, claimed exporter.

comment: HS mapping: 381010 is a good fit for the exothermic welding powder/ignition compound and is the strongest corroborated code. 853690 fits cable lugs, terminal lugs, brass cable glands, earthing clamps and connectors (<=1000V connecting apparatus) - corroborated. 721590 (other bars/rods of iron or non-alloy steel) is only a partial fit: the site's rod line is copper-bonded/copper-clad ground rod, which is a copper-clad steel article rather than a plain steel bar; the correct code depends on copper layer thickness (7407 copper bars/rods vs 7215/7326 steel core) and cannot be resolved from the website - flag for correction at line level, not a rejection ground. Missing from the declaration: 741300 (copper braid/rope/flat, stranded copper conductors), 853540 (lightning protection / surge arresters), 853890 (earth pit and earthing accessories), 831130 (thermit welding kits as welding consumables), and 7326/7308 for fabricated steel items and small track machines. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is an electrical earthing / lightning protection / exothermic welding manufacturer. Oil & gas appears only as an end-use application of pipeline welds, not as a product line. Correct industry: electrical equipment / earthing & lightning protection. All product claims are from the company's own website and catalogue pages (amiableimpex.com, /e-catalogue/, /exothermic-welding/, /cable-lugs-glands/) - no customs line, GST turnover or purchase-order evidence was reviewed here, so actual shipments are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Certifications (UL, RDSO, IEC, IEEE 837-2014) are also self-declared on the site and not independently verified in this task. No PAN/CIN researched per role scope.
